name: Documentation Writing Checklist
description: This module is a pre-completion checklist for documentation writing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a documentation writing task done.
content:
This module is a pre-completion checklist for documentation writing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a documentation writing task done.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. When documentation writing decisions are ambiguous, favor the option that is easiest to reverse or extend later.
2. State assumptions about documentation writing explicitly before proceeding, rather than leaving them implicit.
3. When multiple documentation writing strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
4. Before starting documentation writing work, confirm the scope and constraints so the approach matches the actual requirement.
5. When documentation writing guidance conflicts with a specific user instruction, defer to the user's explicit instruction and note the conflict.
6. Validate documentation writing outputs against a concrete example before treating the work as complete.
7. Measure before optimizing any documentation writing bottleneck; do not guess at what is slow.
8. Keep documentation writing changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
9. Re-check edge cases relevant to documentation writing (empty input, boundary values, concurrent access) before calling the task done.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Avoid mixing unrelated documentation writing concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.
- Do not skip documenting documentation writing assumptions just because they seem obvious in the moment.
- Do not apply generic documentation writing advice without checking it fits the specific context at hand.

CLOSING NOTE
When in doubt, prefer clarity and explicit reasoning about documentation writing over a shortcut that saves a few lines but hides intent.
